audit.whatIsWrong: Chart disagreed with the already-written olaf__yorick mirror, which reads Olaf from level 1 through first item and Yorick at two-plus items. This page had Skill / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Olaf, and whys[2] credited Yorick a Maiden at level 3.
audit.why: Olaf owns every laning stage: Undertow resets its own cooldown on pickup so the slow is permanent, Reckless Swing is true damage armour cannot answer, and Berserker Rage scales attack speed and lifesteal as he drops. It only ends when the map opens — Ragnarok is 80s at rank 3 and does nothing about Maiden taking a tower on the other side.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Olaf / Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side as one paired group, ratings 3/3/3/3/4/3/6. whys[2], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike was cooldown-free (packet defect: sequencingCues 0), and spikes[0].text named 'W Vicious Strikes lifesteal'.
audit.why: Vicious Strikes is a retired ability name — Olaf's W is Tough It Out, and Riot's text for it is attack speed plus a shield with no lifesteal at all. The lifesteal comes from the passive, Berserker Rage, scaling on missing health. This is the same class of fabrication as the calibration examples. The real clock: Undertow flat 9s (reset on pickup), Reckless Swing 11/10/9/8/7s at 325 range, Tough It Out 16s at rank 1, Ragnarok 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, whys[3] and the phases rebuilt with the correct ability names and real cooldowns; the false W-lifesteal claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly said Ragnarok lets Olaf ignore Dark Procession — tldr, report[0].t, spikes[1].text, mid, late and wants.foe[1] all claimed he ults through the cage.
audit.why: Riot's Ragnarok text is 'become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'. Dark Procession is a destructible wall — terrain, not a disable — so it still blocks him. What Ragnarok genuinely beats is Mourning Mist's slow. The distinction changes the whole plan: the slow is worthless during his ultimate, the cage is not, and it should be saved for his commit rather than never used. The mirror reached the same conclusion independently. Second point: Reckless Swing is true damage on 11s at rank 1, so stacking armour is the wrong response and Grievous Wounds against Berserker Rage's lifesteal is the right one.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, winCon, report[1].t, spikes[1].text, mid, late and wants.foe[1] all now say Ragnarok answers the slow but not the wall. Reckless Swing's true damage named in phases[2].why and breakdown.late.

notes: Two things I could not fix and the user should know. (1) dontsFull[1].t reads 'Cage him during his R' (21 chars, under the applier's 25-character floor, so no edit can land). It is now wrong advice — the cage DOES hold him through Ragnarok, since a destructible wall is terrain rather than a disable. Its .d has been rewritten to steer placement instead, and report[11].t no longer repeats the claim, but the title itself needs a manual fix. (2) The mirror also reported dosFull[1].t on the Olaf page reading 'R to cleanse his W cage', same sub-25-char problem, same W/E swap. Ability-name fabrication corrected here: 'W Vicious Strikes lifesteal' — Olaf's W is Tough It Out (attack speed and a shield); the lifesteal is his passive, Berserker Rage. Kit flag misfire as elsewhere: yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash'; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement, so no dash asserted.
